title: Bachche ka Sawaal
text:
Bachcha: Papa, samundar kitna gehra hai?
Papa: Bahut gehra.
Bachcha: Aapko kaise pata?
Papa: Beta, kuch cheezein Google bhi bata deta hai. 🌊

title: Chidiya ka Chhata
text:
Chidiya: Barish ho rahi hai, tumne chhata kyun nahi liya?
Doosri chidiya: Mere paas pankh hain.
Chidiya: Aur geele ho gaye toh?
Doosri: Toh main pankha ban jaungi. 🐦

title: Ghadi ka Jawab
text:
Main: Ghadi, tum kabhi thakti nahi?
Ghadi: Main toh sirf ghoomti hoon.
Main: Toh rukogi kab?
Ghadi: Jab tum time dekhna band kar doge. ⏰

title: Aam ka Ghamand
text:
Aam: Main phalon ka raja hoon.
Kela: Aur main?
Aam: Tum mantri ho.
Kela: Theek hai, par chhilka main hi phelaata hoon. 🍌

title: Kitaab ki Shikayat
text:
Kitaab: Mujhe kholo.
Student: Kal pakka.
Kitaab: Ye "kal" 3 saal se chal raha hai.
Student: Dekha, tum bhi toh purani nahi hui. 📗

title: Bulb aur Switch
text:
Bulb: Tum mujhe roz off kar dete ho.
Switch: Tum roz jal jaate ho.
Bulb: Ye toh mera kaam hai.
Switch: Aur mera mood. 💡

title: Nanhe ka Ganit
text:
Teacher: Agar tumhare paas 4 toffee hain aur main 2 le lun, toh kya bachega?
Bachcha: Ladai, ma'am. 🍬

title: Chaand aur Suraj
text:
Chaand: Tum din me chamakte ho, main raat me.
Suraj: Toh problem kya hai?
Chaand: Tumhe sab dekhte hain, mujhe sirf shayar. 🌙

title: Bottle ki Baat
text:
Bottle: Main aadhi khali hoon.
Gilas: Main aadha bhara hoon.
Main: Dono chup ho jao, mujhe pyaas lagi hai. 🥤

title: Seedha Jawab
text:
Teacher: Batao, paani ka doosra naam kya hai?
Bachcha: Ma'am, mujhe uska pehla naam hi yaad nahi aa raha. 💧

title: Chhata aur Barish
text:
Chhata: Tum aate ho toh mujhe kaam milta hai.
Barish: Aur main na aaun toh?
Chhata: Toh main almari me philosopher ban jaata hoon. ☔

title: Dadaji ki Yaadashth
text:
Dadaji: Mujhe sab yaad rehta hai.
Main: Toh chashma kahan hai?
Dadaji: Aankh pe.
Main: Aur main?
Dadaji: Tum bhi samne ho, par naam bhool gaya. 👓

title: Kachhua aur Khargosh 2.0
text:
Khargosh: Is baar main nahi soyunga.
Kachhua: Main bhi nahi bhagunga.
Dono race me khade rahe.
Race aaj bhi chal rahi hai. 🐢

title: Nanhi Shart
text:
Bachcha: Mummy, agar main sabzi kha lun toh?
Mummy: Toh chocolate milegi.
Bachcha: Aur agar na khaun?
Mummy: Toh sabzi milegi.
Bachcha: Deal ek hi hai, dikhawa do hai. 🥦

title: Ped ki Shikayat
text:
Ped: Log mujhse chhaya lete hain aur dhanyavaad nahi dete.
Hawa: Main bhi chalti hoon, koi nahi kehta.
Ped: Chalo, hum dono ek hi team me hain. 🌳

title: Sapna aur Neend
text:
Sapna: Main tabhi aata hoon jab tum sote ho.
Neend: Aur main tabhi aati hoon jab alarm bajne wala ho.
Dono ne milkar meri subah barbaad kar di. 😪
